name: Check-in desk
adds: Passengers buy their tickets here: stand behind the desk to check them in

name: Gate 1
adds: A stand for a propeller plane: open the gate, then clear it for take-off

name: Fuel truck
adds: Planes fill up before they leave and fly further: +30% on every flight

name: Lounge seats
adds: Somewhere to sit by the gates: passengers wait far longer at check-in, and more come

name: Gate 2
adds: A second stand: two planes on the ground at once, and many more passengers

name: Check-in agent
adds: Checks passengers in for you, all day long

name: Baggage belt and cart
adds: Cases come out on the belt: carry them to each plane, for +30% on every flight

name: Ground handler
adds: Loads the cases and fuels the planes for you

name: Ramp dispatcher
adds: Opens the gates and waves each flight off once it's ready, so the airport earns while you're away (step on as the ring closes yourself for a perfect take-off)
